[h1]More fun with friends![/h1]
Really fun Roguelite FPS. All weapons are distinctively different in a way that they feel fun to use. Together with the amount of different builds you can play as gives the sense of variety that makes you return to the game. The coop is really fun.

[h2]Difficulty[/h2]
The enemy damage resistance caps at 90% on Boundless Dream, whilst you still one shot the enemies. Some additional ways to make this more difficult would be cool other than just a new reincarnation level.
(Endless Journey on Reincarnation 9 adds a timer for you to race against.)

[h2]Customization[/h2]
The "new" season reward stuff gives some really cool weapon skins and emotes. Unfortunately there is no "sandbox mode" (for the lack of a better word), so testing different builds will take some time while you unlock weapons and scrolls, and level up characters, there is no way to give yourself scrolls at the start of the game for some challenge runs (like [i]Flesh and Bones[/i] with [i]Paranormality[/i] for 1hp runs). And [i]if I deciphered the [url=store.steampowered.com/eula/1217060_eula_0]Gunfire Reborn EULA[/url] correctly[/i] you are [i][b]not allowed to modify[/b][/i] the game in any way, shape, or form.

[h2]Updates[/h2]
The [i]free[/i] season updates are really cool, adding a new gameplay mechanic and some awesome weapon skins. The old gameplay gimmicks are also playable after the season ends which allows those who didn't get to experience them during the actual season have a go at them. After the season ends the rewards can be purchased from the shop with Soul Essence (in game currency) that is basically free anyway.

[h3]System Requirements[/h3]
The actual system requirements for this game are really low, allowing you to play to the fullest on even lower end laptops, making it really accessible for anyone who would like to try it out.

[h1]Overall 4/5[/h1]
The movement feels nice and there's great sense of variety even though it has a very repetitive gameplay loop. Would be more fun with a "sandbox mode" and/or being allowed to modify the game.

This game has crazy amounts of replayability and a very fun gameplay loop with friends or alone. Winning runs may run a little long and the art direction isnt my favorite, but this game deserves overwhelmingly positive reviews fr. Been coming back to this gem since beta and intend to keep doing so as the devs add more.
Definitely a roguelike goat for me
Thank goodness this was on Game Pass because I would have never tried this out...and thanks to game pass I bought the game. Great job devs this is Enter The Gungeon the way i wanted it to be!

Pros
Engaging Game-play: Fast-paced shooting combined with deep rogue like mechanics.
Replay ability: Procedural generated levels and a variety of heroes and weapons keep things fresh.
Co-op Fun: Multiplayer mode adds a layer of chaotic fun and strategy if there nice.
Charming Art Style: Vibrant, cartoonist visuals that are both unique and appealing.

Cons
Repetition: Some players might find the rogue like nature repetitive after extended play.
Limited Story: The light narrative may not appeal to those looking for a deep story line.
